test_categorical_trivial: test the CategoricalTest class to verify trivial simplex categorical distribution compilation to DOT graph
test_categorical_dirichlet: test the CategoricalTest class to verify Dirichlet output as input to a categorical distribution
test_categorical_equivalent_consts: test the CategoricalTest class to verify deduplication of equivalent constant categorical distributions
test_categorical_random_logit: test the CategoricalTest class to verify unsupported random logit categorical raises ValueError
test_categorical_multi: test the CategoricalTest class to verify multi-dimensional categorical raises ValueError with correct message
